profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at GEICO
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the various industry fields. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed REST APIs for GEICO Mobile App.
Designed and developed Azure DevOps pipelines.
positions.insights: Skills: YAML · DevOps · Microsoft Azure · C# · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Code Review · API Development · Git · .NET · Cursor AI · Azure DevOps · Splunk · GitHub · Grafana

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Fee For Service Data Collection System for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
o	Developed front-end and back-end of help content search page functionality
o	Migrated Spring Security 3.x to 4.x to enable CSRF protection
o	Configured content version strategy to prevent caching of static resources
o	Developed new features across all layers of the application
o	Developed test cases using mockito and spring dbunit
Technologies: Java, JSP, JSTL, HTML, CSS, jQuery, Spring, Spring MVC, JPA, Hibernate, JPQL, MySQL, Maven, ActiveMQ, JBoss EAP

•	Fraud Investigation Database for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
o	Developed frontend, backend, and database changes based on change requests
o	Developed Excel file import functionality for adding subject information with Apache POI
o	Developed Servlet filter for preventing cross-site scripting based on blacklist
o	Handled deployment of changes into system testing environment
o	Created Ant build script for project used for data extraction and configured it in CruiseControl
Technologies: Java, JSP, JSTL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Spring, Struts, EJB, JDBC, Spring JDBC, SQL, Castor, Oracle, PL/SQL, Ant, WebSphere MQ, WebSphere Application Server, CruiseControl

•	Open Payments for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
o	Integrated CSS into JSP created with JSF Widget Library
o	Developed frontend and backend of attestation process of payment record submission workflow
o	Developed front-end functionality of viewing and editing payment record
Technologies: Java, JSP, JSTL, HTML, CSS, jQuery, Spring, JSF, iBATIS, SQL, JiBX, Oracle, Ant, WebSphere MQ, Websphere Application Server, Jenkins
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JavaScript · jQuery · Oracle Database · MySQL · Spring MVC · SQL · PL/SQL · Spring Framework · Struts

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Mobile Supply Chain Management Portal
o	Analyzed requirements and provided estimates
o	Designed and Developed new operations for data collection to an existing web service with JAX-WS
o	Developed unit tests for new operations of web service with JUnit
o	Developed analytical reports using JasperReports based on data collected by web service
o	Converted Microsoft SQL Server SQL into Oracle SQL for database migration
o	Created DML, DDL, and stored procedures for database changes
Technologies: Java, JSP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, YUI, EJB, Struts, Castor, JDBC, JAX-WS, JUnit, SQL, JasperReports, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, CruiseControl
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Oracle Database · SQL · Microsoft SQL Server · Struts

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Enterprise Interactive Voice Response
o	Created technical design document
o	Designed and developed web service that provides eligibility information
o	Designed and developed web service for collecting data of a caller
o	Designed and developed new processes to web service used for call routing
o	Provided deployment plan and technical support on production releases
o	Configured and maintained report data importing batch job
o	Collaborated with DBA to create database archiving process for audit tables
o	Provided on-call production support
Technologies: Java, Spring, Hibernate, JDBC, JAX-RPC, SQL, Microsoft SQL Server

•	Unified Service System
o	Developed modules and extensions in Epiphany Sales & Service
o	Developed LoadRunner scripts for load testing
o	Provided technical support on production releases
	Technologies: Java, Ant, Epiphany Sales & Service, LoadRunner
positions.insights: Skills: Java · API Development · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Freelance Developer
positions.description:
• Created XHTML documents from given word documents
• Created invoice templates in XHTML and CSS
• Fixed CSS layout problem of a given template
• Converted Seattle Academy website into standards-compliant XHTML/CSS website
• Developed back-end of information request form
• Created a template of contact form
• Created a script to perform a daily batch process in PHP and scheduled a cron job
Technologies: XHTML, CSS, PHP, MySQL
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · PHP · HTML

positions.title: IT Specialist Assistant
positions.description:
• Maintained UMBC Graduate School website 
• Converted the UMBC Graduate School website into standards-compliant XHTML/CSS website
•  Implemented UMBC Nonexempt Staff Senate website with Drupal
• Updated tech document in dokuwiki
• Updated and created fillable forms in Word and PDF format
• Documented visual basic code of the department databases in Access
•  Managed tasks with the department ticket system
• Provided technical support to internal and external faculties
• Managed department IT inventory
Technologies: XHTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Drupal
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · PHP · HTML · CSS
